message: The checkout refactor removed the guard for carts without a coupon.

root_cause.explanation: Commit d4e5f6a reads cart.coupon.code unconditionally. Carts without a coupon raise AttributeError before a payment is attempted.

evidence.summary: The refactor removed the None check from coupon handling.
evidence.detail:
commit d4e5f6a  simplify coupon handling
--- a/app/checkout.py
+++ b/app/checkout.py
@@ -26,3 +26,3 @@
 def submit(cart):
-    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code if cart.coupon else None
+    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code
     return calculate_total(cart.items, coupon_code)

[RECORDED REHEARSAL]
def test_checkout_without_coupon():
    cart = Cart(items=[Item("coffee", 1200)], coupon=None)
    assert submit(cart).status == "paid"

FAILED: AttributeError at app/checkout.py:27

message: Three coupon-handling patches are ready for isolated verification.

candidates.title: Guard an absent coupon
candidates.rationale: Read the coupon code only when a coupon exists. Preserve the existing validation path for supplied coupons.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/checkout.py
+++ b/app/checkout.py
@@ -26,3 +26,3 @@
 def submit(cart):
-    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code
+    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code if cart.coupon is not None else None
     return calculate_total(cart.items, coupon_code)

candidates.title: Use an empty coupon
candidates.rationale: Create a placeholder coupon to avoid a null dereference; validation may reject the empty code.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/checkout.py
+++ b/app/checkout.py
@@ -26,3 +26,3 @@
 def submit(cart):
-    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code
+    coupon_code = (cart.coupon or Coupon(code="")).code
     return calculate_total(cart.items, coupon_code)

candidates.title: Skip coupon handling
candidates.rationale: Remove the coupon read entirely. This avoids the exception but risks dropping valid discounts.
candidates.patch:
--- a/app/checkout.py
+++ b/app/checkout.py
@@ -26,3 +26,3 @@
 def submit(cart):
-    coupon_code = cart.coupon.code
+    coupon_code = None
     return calculate_total(cart.items, coupon_code)
